newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March S&Ps end higher despite late selloff.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March S&Ps end higher despite late selloff.

text.p: U.S. March Standard & Poor's 500 futures managed to close higher, despite falling in the last hour of trade on heavy profit-taking, traders and analysts said.
"Everyone and their sisters and dogs were selling," one Standard & Poor's 500 futures trader said.
The selling touched off a cascade of sell-stop orders, which attracted even more selling. He said sell-stop orders were particularly heavy at 775.00.
One analyst attributed the sell-off to S&P 500s' overbought condition.
